description: Named poll sequences. Plain JSON, not an Example Object. Each scenario starts with keyrequest/created.json (interval 3). Each step is one poll: fixture names a file in this directory (without .json); override, when present, replaces members of that fixture's value for this step; wait_seconds is how long the tool waits, from the arrival of the previous reply, before the poll (a slow_down reply raises the interval to 5, so later waits are 5). outcome says what the tool does after the step. Every poll outcome appears in at least one scenario.

scenarios.name: approved
scenarios.description: pending, then a too-early poll, then pending at the new interval, then approved once, then consumed.

steps.outcome: stop and report; a tool that stored the key does not poll again

scenarios.name: denied
scenarios.description: pending, then a person denies it.

scenarios.name: expired
scenarios.description: pending until the time runs out.

scenarios.name: unauthorized
scenarios.description: a wrong poll secret or an unknown id: reported, and the request is kept.

scenarios.name: lost-reply
scenarios.description: the approved reply never reached the tool, so the next poll gets consumed and the tool must file a new request.

steps.outcome: stop and report; file a new request on the next use
